results.title: General Manager – Commercial Vehicles & Heavy Equipment
results.description: A well-positioned and growing organization in the heavy vehicles and equipment sector, focused on expanding its presence across trucks, buses, and related solutions. The company is in a phase of development, aiming to strengthen its market position and operational capabilities. Job Purpose To provide overall leadership and direction for the business, overseeing sales, aftersales, and operational functions. The role is responsible for driving revenue growth, improving market share, and ensuring efficient and profitable business performance across all areas. Key Responsibilities Provide strategic and operational leadership across all business functions Take full ownership of P&L, revenue performance, and business outcomes Develop and implement business strategies for heavy vehicles and equipment portfolio Identify and pursue new business opportunities, key accounts, and market segments Establish and maintain relationships with government entities, fleet customers, and major clients Oversee sales and aftersales operations, ensuring service quality and customer satisfaction Drive market positioning, pricing strategies, and competitor analysis Ensure effective inventory management, supply chain coordination, and operational efficiency Expand aftersales business including service contracts, parts, and maintenance programs Lead, develop, and manage a high-performing team Qualifications and Skills 15+ years of relevant experience in heavy vehicles, trucks, buses, or equipment industry Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related discipline Proven experience in a senior leadership role managing full business operations Solid understanding of commercial vehicles and equipment business Experience across both sales and aftersales functions Commercially focused with a practical and hands-on approach Good awareness of regional market dynamics Leadership, communication, and decision-making capabilities

The role is responsible for managing a large-scale frontline team operating from a remote operations center, monitoring autonomous vehicles, resolving live incidents, and coordinating field support activities to ensure safe and efficient fleet performance. Develop and maintain SOPs, training programs, and quality assurance processes. Manage supervisors and shift leaders across a 24/7 operation. Coordinate workforce logistics, including manpower suppliers, accommodation, transport, and resource allocation. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Operations, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field. 8+ years of experience managing large-scale operations, control rooms, command centers, contact centers, or remote operations environments. Proven experience leading teams of 200+ employees. Strong knowledge of workforce management, performance monitoring, and operational KPIs. Experience building training, certification, and quality management programs. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Strong English communication skills; additional languages such as Hindi, Urdu, or Arabic are an advantage. Valid UAE driving license preferred. Based in Abu Dhabi or willing to relocate. Preferred Experience Autonomous vehicle, mobility, logistics, or technology-driven operations. UAE workforce operations, manpower management, and multi-shift environments. Experience scaling teams and launching new operational centers. What We Offer Competitive salary package. Visa sponsorship. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge autonomous delivery technology. results.title: Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles
results.description: 🚛 Hiring: Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles | Kuwait We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established automotive and commercial vehicle organisation in Kuwait for an experienced Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles to lead its service and workshop operations. This is a senior operational role responsible for driving workshop performance, service quality, profitability, team productivity and customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities: • Manage the overall Commercial Vehicle Service & Workshop operation , ensuring efficient workflow and productivity. • Lead and manage service advisors, technicians, workshop personnel and support teams. • Monitor workshop productivity, utilisation, repair quality and turnaround times . • Ensure vehicles are completed and delivered on time while maintaining manufacturer and service standards. • Manage escalated customer issues and ensure effective resolution. • Monitor and improve service revenue, labour sales, parts consumption, warranty performance and workshop profitability . • Plan workshop manpower, tools, equipment and capacity according to business requirements. • Drive continuous improvement across workshop operations and customer service. Candidate Requirements: • Minimum 8–10 years' experience within automotive or commercial vehicle service/workshop operations. • Proven experience as a Service Manager, Workshop Manager or similar leadership role . • Strong preference for candidates with experience in commercial vehicles, trucks, buses or heavy-duty vehicles . • Strong knowledge of workshop operations, productivity and service KPIs. • Demonstrable experience managing and developing workshop/service teams. • Commercial understanding of service revenue, labour, parts, warranty and profitability. • Strong customer management and problem-solving skills. • Must currently be based in Kuwait and available for local recruitment. • Transferable Kuwait residency preferred. 📍 Location: Kuwait 🚛 Sector: Automotive / Commercial Vehicles 💼 Position: Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles If you have strong commercial vehicle workshop management experience and are currently based in Kuwait, please apply.

results.title: Divisional Operations Manager- Road Transport
results.description: 📢📢📢 We are looking for a Divisional Operations Manager- Road Transport (RT) Operations, based in Riyadh. JOB PURPOSE: To lead and oversee the overall RT operations across assigned locations, ensuring safe, efficient, reliable, and cost-effective operations through optimum fleet and manpower utilization, effective fleet availability and maintenance coordination, fuel and tyre cost control, strong safety culture, customer satisfaction, operational visibility, and continuous improvement, while achieving business objectives and agreed KPIs. To ensure that safety and environmental aspects of Sustainability are embedded into the business strategy and daily operations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Fleet Utilization & Availability Monitor fleet utilization on a daily basis and identify opportunities for improvement. Conduct daily fleet availability checks and coordinate with Maintenance to minimize vehicle downtime. Monitor fleet running kilometres on daily basis and control unnecessary or excess running. 2. Driver Management & Utilization Monitor driver availability and utilization on a daily basis. Plan and manage driver scheduling to ensure optimum utilization and minimize idle time. Ensure adequate driver availability to meet daily customer requirements. 3. Fuel Management & Cost Reduction Monitor fuel mileage/consumption and implement actions to improve mileage. Investigate abnormal fuel consumption and take corrective action. Control unnecessary vehicle running and identify opportunities for fuel cost reduction. 4. Tyre Management Monitor tyre utilization, replacement and performance. Implement effective controls to maximize tyre life and reduce tyre-related costs. Coordinate with Maintenance for timely inspection and corrective action. 5. Safety & Compliance Drive a strong safety culture across the driver and RT Operations teams with hearts and minds approach. Monitor driver safety performance and ensure compliance with company safety standards. Take proactive action to address unsafe practices and recurring safety concerns. Conduct enroute spot checks and reporting. Conduct pre-loading and vehicle & integrity checks. Incident reporting and participation in Incident investigation. 6. Customer Management Maintain close coordination with customers regarding daily orders and operational requirements. Ensure timely follow-up and resolution of customer requirements and operational issues. Maintain strong customer relationships and improve service satisfaction. Increase the revenues by increased truck utilization. 7. Maintenance Coordination Work closely with the Maintenance team to improve fleet availability and reliability. Support initiatives to reduce maintenance costs and improve preventive maintenance practices. Monitor recurring vehicle issues and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented. 8. Continuous Improvement Identify and implement new initiatives to improve operational efficiency, productivity and cost effectiveness. Establish appropriate KPIs and provide management with clear visibility of operational performance. Continuously review processes and identify opportunities for improvement. 9. Overall RT Operations Management Take overall responsibility for RT Operations at the assigned location. Preparation of daily, weekly and monthly reports and sharing with the stakeholders Participation in customer engagements and BPR Ensure daily operations are properly planned, controlled and executed. Monitor operational performance and take timely corrective action where required. Ensure alignment between Operations, Drivers, Maintenance, Customers and Management. Follow-up for Customer payments

results.title: Team Leader , Logistics
results.description: About noon We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Team Leader, Logistics who can help us move even faster. Noon’s fastest hyper-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localised assortment of FMCG & grocery products with delivery within 15 minutes. Currently live across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time. noon’s mission: Every door, every day. What you’ll do: Effectively manage the assigned fleet across 3-5 Dark Stores within the cluster, consistently meeting target KPIs. Supervise Fleet Managers, overseeing daily operations to ensure the smooth and efficient execution of fleet activities. Ensure rigorous adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compliance with all operational standards. Support efficient manpower allocation across all stores in the cluster Mentor and guide the team, fostering high performance and proactively addressing operational challenges. Maintain clear, timely, and effective communication with all stakeholders to ensure complete operational alignment. What you’ll need: Minimum 2 years of experience in Logistics, managing teams. Excellent communication and coordination skills. A hands-on approach—willing to roll up your sleeves and get involved. Comfortable working in highly ambiguous situations and adapting to change. Understanding of logistics metrics and ability to manage stakeholders effectively. Flexibility in work schedule to accommodate operational needs. Who will excel? We’re looking for people with high standards who understand that hard work matters. You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action. We need people with the courage to be fiercely original. noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

results.title: Supervisor - Fleet
results.description: Job description: We’re Hiring | Supervisor - Fleet Join NADEC and play a key role in maintaining a safe, reliable, and highly available fleet that supports our daily distribution operations. As a Fleet Workshop Supervisor , you will oversee workshop and fleet maintenance activities, ensuring maximum vehicle availability, minimum downtime, effective maintenance cost control, and reliable operation of vehicles and their cooling/refrigeration units . Location: Hail Key Responsibilities Maximize fleet availability and minimize vehicle downtime through effective maintenance planning and follow-up. Plan and monitor preventive and corrective maintenance within agreed timelines. Manage workshop manpower, workflow, productivity, quality, and safety. Control maintenance costs without compromising vehicle reliability, safety, quality, or appearance. Provide technical guidance and support to workshop and operating teams. Ensure effective maintenance and follow-up of vehicle cooling units and refrigeration systems . Coordinate with leasing companies and service providers for maintenance and accident repairs. Ensure timely completion and monitoring of TAMM, Bayan, TGA , and other fleet regulatory requirements. Ensure accurate and timely SAP updates and maintenance records. Monitor fleet-related activities including fuel, GPS, HHT, and operational equipment. Maintain vehicle condition, livery, workshop scrap records, and asset documentation. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly fleet/workshop performance reports. Coordinate with Sales and other functions to resolve fleet-related operational issues. Drive continuous improvement and cost-saving initiatives while maintaining service quality. What We’re Looking For Automobile/Mechanical Engineering qualification or Higher Diploma. 2–3 years of relevant Fleet/Workshop/Maintenance experience. Strong hands-on knowledge of commercial vehicle preventive and corrective maintenance. Good technical knowledge of vehicle cooling/refrigeration units . Experience managing workshop teams, workflow, productivity, and safety. Familiarity with ERP/SAP systems. Strong troubleshooting, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities. FMCG, dairy, food distribution, or temperature-controlled fleet experience is highly preferred.

results.title: VP of Operational Excellence (Ports/Logistics)
results.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: We are partnering with a major Abu Dhabi based investment platform to appoint two Operational Excellence leaders into its Ports & Logistics platform. One role focuses on ports and maritime operations, the other on logistics, delivery and last mile. This is an operating partner style role, not a traditional strategy seat. You will work directly with portfolio company leadership teams to lift operational performance, challenge how the businesses runs, and turn improvement initiatives into measurable results. What you'll do Maintain clear visibility of operational performance across portfolio companies and spot where value is being lost Challenge and support opco management on productivity, asset utilization, service quality and cost Build KPI frameworks, benchmarking against leading global operators, and executive performance dashboards Lead and track improvement programmes through to measurable value realization Work alongside opco CEOs and operations leaders as a trusted, credible peer What you'll bring Typically 7 to 14 years of experience, with hands-on operational exposure in ports, terminals, logistics, express delivery, last mile or transport A track record of delivering quantified operational improvement, not just recommending it Strong grounding in Lean, Six Sigma or continuous improvement methods Industry operators, portfolio operations professionals, or consultants from operations and performance improvement practices with deep sector focus are all welcome The confidence and presence to engage chief executives and hold your ground on the numbers What's on offer A competitive tax free package with performance bonus, education allowance and full benefits, plus the chance to shape performance across some of the region's most significant transport and logistics assets. UAE Nationals are strongly encouraged to apply. All applications are treated in strict confidence.

results.title: Logistics & Port Transformation Director
results.description: نُجري بحثاً سرياً لتعيين مدير تحول للموانئ والخدمات اللوجستية لقيادة برنامج تحديث رئيسي للموانئ والخدمات اللوجستية لمؤسسة مقرها جدة، بنظام العمل من الموقع بالكامل. تُعدّ جدة محورية لطموحات المملكة اللوجستية ضمن رؤية 2030، وهذه فرصة على مستوى الإدارة العليا لقائد عمليات قادر على قيادة التحول عبر بوابة الساحل الغربي للمملكة. في هذا الدور، ستتولى ملكية خارطة طريق التحول لعمليات الموانئ والخدمات اللوجستية بما يتوافق مع أهداف الاستراتيجية الوطنية للنقل والخدمات اللوجستية ضمن رؤية 2030، وتقود التواصل مع الهيئة العامة للموانئ السعودية (موانئ) بشأن التخطيط للطاقة الاستيعابية، والتحول الرقمي، والامتثال التنظيمي، وتدير التكامل التشغيلي عبر أنشطة الحاويات والبضائع السائبة والمناطق اللوجستية في ميناء الملك عبدالله وميناء جدة الإسلامي. ستقود التخطيط للقوى العاملة المتوافق مع متطلبات السعودة وبرنامج نطاقات عبر العمليات اللوجستية، وتدفع مبادرات الأتمتة والممرات اللوجستية الرقمية لرفع أداء الإنتاجية ومدة مكوث البضائع. ستبني وتقود تنظيماً تشغيلياً متعدد المواقع، وتعمل بالشراكة مع الجمارك وسلطات المناطق الحرة وخطوط الشحن لضمان أداء سلسلة الإمداد من طرفها إلى طرفها، وتمثّل برنامج التحول أمام موانئ وأصحاب المصلحة الحكوميين والقيادة التنفيذية. كما ستتولى ملكية دراسة الجدوى التجارية وخطة التنفيذ للتوسع التدريجي في الطاقة الاستيعابية. مؤهلات إضافية مرغوبة: خبرة مباشرة في العمل مع الهيئة العامة للموانئ السعودية (موانئ) أو التبعية التنظيمية لها خلفية في عمليات الموانئ بميناء الملك عبدالله أو ميناء جدة الإسلامي أو بوابة خليجية مماثلة خبرة في تنفيذ تحول للقوى العاملة متوافق مع متطلبات السعودة وبرنامج نطاقات سجل حافل في برامج لوجستية أو بنية تحتية متوافقة مع رؤية 2030 إجادة عملية للغة العربية في سياق تشغيلي أو تنظيمي We are conducting a confidential search for a Logistics & Port Transformation Director to lead a major port and logistics modernisation programme for an organisation based in Jeddah, working on-site. Jeddah is central to Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 logistics ambitions, and this is a director-level opportunity for an operations leader who can drive transformation across the Kingdom's western seaboard gateway. In this role, you will own the transformation roadmap for port and logistics operations aligned to Vision 2030 National Transport and Logistics Strategy targets, lead engagement with Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) on capacity planning, digitalisation, and regulatory compliance, and direct operational integration across King Abdullah Port and Jeddah Islamic Port container, bulk, and logistics zone activities. You will lead Saudization and Nitaqat-compliant workforce planning across the logistics operation, and drive automation and digital freight corridor initiatives to lift throughput and dwell-time performance. You will build and lead a multi-site operations organisation, partner with customs, free zone authorities, and shipping lines on end-to-end supply chain performance, and represent the transformation programme to Mawani, government stakeholders, and executive leadership. You will also own the business case and delivery plan for phased capacity expansion. Nice to Have: Direct experience working with or reporting into Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) Background in port operations at King Abdullah Port, Jeddah Islamic Port, or a comparable Gulf gateway Experience delivering Saudization/Nitaqat-compliant workforce transformation Track record on Vision 2030-aligned logistics or infrastructure programmes Working knowledge of Arabic in an operational or regulatory context Nice to have Direct experience working with or reporting into Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) Background in port operations at King Abdullah Port, Jeddah Islamic Port, or a comparable Gulf gateway Experience delivering Saudization/Nitaqat-compliant workforce transformation Track record on Vision 2030-aligned logistics or infrastructure programmes Working knowledge of Arabic in an operational or regulatory context
